definitions.explanation: A male sibling who is younger than oneself. Used for both one's own younger brother and others' younger brothers.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧です。
examples.english: My younger brother is a high school student.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}びました→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: I played with my younger brother.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧5⟦{歳|さい}→歳：10017_sai⟧⟦{年下|としした}→年下：07303_toshishita⟧です。
examples.english: My younger brother is 5 years younger than me.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧、⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦そうです→そうです：03098_soudesu⟧。
examples.english: My younger brother practices soccer every day. He says he wants to become a pro in the future.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ていました→見る：00283_miru⟧。⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弟|おとうと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧です。
examples.english: When my younger brother was small, I often took care of him. Now he's taller than me.

notes:
{弟|おとうと} means younger brother. Unlike ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧/⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧, the humble/polite distinction is less strict for younger siblings.

FAMILY TERM SYSTEM:
- {弟|おとうと}: younger brother (your own or general)
- ⟦{弟|おとうと}さん→弟さん：27447_otoutosan⟧: younger brother (polite, someone else's)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {弟|おとうと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to have a younger brother
- {弟|おとうと}⟦みたいに→みたい：10755_mitai⟧: like a younger brother
- {弟|おとうと}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: someone like a younger brother (figurative)

FAMILY TERMS (complete set):
- ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧/⟦お{兄|にい}さん→お兄さん：02858_oniisan⟧: older brother
- ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧/⟦お{姉|ねえ}さん→お姉さん：02859_oneesan⟧: older sister
- {弟|おとうと}/⟦{弟|おとうと}さん→弟さん：27447_otoutosan⟧: younger brother
- ⟦{妹|いもうと}→妹：00573_imouto⟧/⟦{妹|いもうと}さん→妹さん：27448_imoutosan⟧: younger sister

NOTE:
⟦{義弟|ぎてい}→義弟：13981_gitei⟧ or ⟦{義理|ぎり}→義理：10891_giri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弟|おとうと} means 'brother-in-law' (younger).
